posts.text: Indian F&O Historical Datasets (NSE, BSE & MCX) — If you’ve ever tried backtesting multi-leg option strategies, straddles, or intraday momentum setups using data collected directly from retail WebSocket feeds (Kite Connect, Fyers, etc.), you’ve probably run into common data hygiene issues: missing candles, dropped ticks during high-volatility moves, and rate-limit gaps . To help developers and quant backtesters build cleaner models, I’ve compiled and structured institutional-grade historical derivatives data sourced from authorized market vendors. Segment / Exchange Granularity Period Covered…
